about_short_description.short_description: Leading EdTech platform leveraging AI to provide personalized, adaptive learning experiences for students and teachers.

product.name: EduSofx Copilot
product.description: An AI tool that simplifies complex topics into manageable steps, provides lesson summaries, and evaluates comprehension with testing tools.

product.name: AI-Driven Planning Automation
product.description: A service that automates lesson planning, reducing preparation time and allowing educators to focus on student engagement.

product.name: AI-Driven Question Generation
product.description: A service that generates tailored, standard-aligned questions for assignments and tests to reflect course content and learning objectives.

product.name: Question Generation Tool
product.description: A feature that creates tailored, standard-aligned questions for assignments and tests to ensure varied assessments.

product.name: LMS Integration
product.description: A service that connects EduSofx's AI capabilities with existing learning management systems to enhance educational environments.

product.name: AI Adoption Maturity Framework
product.description: A strategic guide for educational institutions to integrate AI through five stages, focusing on adaptability and competency-based education.
